questions.body: How do we serve /_shared/ on GitHub Pages? Today we copy into each project's docs/_shared/ via /plan-style refresh. Is that the long-term answer, or do we want a GitHub Action that syncs from dotfiles automatically?

The new plan.html/project.html/inventory.html/sprint.html/decisions.html templates use React from CDN. Should new plans actually use them, or stick with the existing vanilla-JS pattern (like this very page)?

followups.title: Confirm imas-efit pages render via local docs-server (no Pages site)
followups.body: imas-efit Pages is disabled — verify rendering only on localhost:8765/imas-efit/. Spot-check top-level (index.html, inventory.html) and one curated/ (build-system-restructure.html), confirming the new _shared/ CSS resolves and the plan-test hook attributes appear in the rendered #plan-meta div.
followups.prompt:
Project: imas-efit
Plan:    redesign-rollout (https://simon-mcintosh.github.io/imas-ambix/redesign-rollout.html — note: this followup lives in the ambix repo because efit has no public Pages)
Section: 13 — imas-efit migration
Tier:    haiku

Context
  The plan-system redesign rolled out across 3 repos on 2026-05-21. imas-efit's
  CSS migration landed at 59d124f8 (develop). imas-efit has no GitHub Pages site
  (private repo). Need to spot-check that the docs-server renders top-level
  and curated/ pages correctly with the new _shared/ CSS, AND that the
  plan-test hook attributes on build-system-restructure.html appear in the
  DOM (they don't run anything; just need to be present for /plan-test to read).

State to read
  docs/state/imas-ambix/redesign-rollout.json   (this followup)
  No imas-efit state file required.

Locked decisions to honour
  ship-via-pages → github-pages (ambix only; efit stays internal)
  shared-css-relative-href → href="_shared/foundation.css" (no leading slash)

Open decisions to surface (do not resolve)
  shared-css-delivery, rank-storage, conflict-detection (from prototype §05)
  project-accent (whether imas-ambix uses a warm-orange project.css)

Constraints
  - Run-only: no edits. If a render is broken, file a separate followup
    rather than fixing inline.
  - Use curl from localhost — do NOT try to access the imas-efit URL
    over the internet (no Pages).

Done-when
  1. curl /imas-efit/index.html and /imas-efit/curated/build-system-restructure.html
     return 200 with the new _shared/ asset paths resolving.
  2. grep finds data-test-source/data-test-parse attributes in the served
     HTML of build-system-restructure.html.
  3. This followup is marked resolved with outcome 'verified renders OK'
     (or detailing what failed).
  4. If verified OK, the next followup in this state file is "done — no
     followup" (close the chain).
